name: 🧩 Suggest a project-based tutorial for py-simple-wrap

title: 🧩 Suggest a project-based tutorial for py-simple-wrap
labels: documentation, good first issue, help wanted, good-first-issue
---
`py-simple-wrap` has tutorials for individual modules, but not many that show modules working together.

This issue is an invitation to write a **project-based tutorial** — pick 2 or more `py-simple-wrap` modules and combine them into a small, fun build (a game, a generator, a little tool — whatever sounds fun to make).

### A few guidelines

- **Combine at least 2 modules.** e.g. `easy_random` + `easy_game`, or `easy_csv` + `easy_data_visualization`.
- **Keep the result fun.** This isn't a dry feature demo — think "small project someone would actually want to build for fun."
- **Match the tone and structure** of the existing tutorials in [`docs/tutorial/`](https://github.com/sara-czasak/py-simple-wrap/tree/main/docs/tutorial) — a short intro, the build itself, a "What happened?" breakdown, and a "Why use these helpers?" closer. Guide: [Contributor Hub](https://sara-czasak.github.io/py-simple-wrap/docs/contributor-hub/tutorial_template/)

Once it's written, add it under [`docs/tutorial/`](https://github.com/sara-czasak/py-simple-wrap/tree/main/docs/tutorial) and add a line for it in [`mkdocs.yml`](https://github.com/sara-czasak/py-simple-wrap/blob/main/mkdocs.yml) under `Tutorial: > Project Based Tutorials:`, following the same format as the existing entries.

Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sara-czasak/py-simple-wrap/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before you start, and feel free to ask questions here!

**Links:**
- Modules to pick from: [`README.md`](https://github.com/sara-czasak/py-simple-wrap/blob/main/README.md), under `## 🛠️ Module Menu`
- Where the tutorial goes: [`docs/tutorial/`](https://github.com/sara-czasak/py-simple-wrap/tree/main/docs/tutorial)
- Contributing guide: [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/sara-czasak/py-simple-wrap/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
